comment: Source read at vcv-octobir commit 996088e (plugin.json version 2.2.0), whose opc submodule is pinned at October-Production-Co a0b8b68; the module is plugins/octobir/vcv-rack/src/opc-vcv-ir.hpp and the DSP is libs/octobir-core. The panel SVG is nearly empty because every control is drawn at runtime with NanoVG, so the panel names above were read from the VCV library screenshot. The load, CLR, previous, next and SWAP buttons are plain widgets rather than parameters, so no click on them can reach a help line; they are covered by Note lines instead. The file dialog filter at opc-vcv-ir.cpp:474 offers wav, aiff, aif and flac, but IRLoader::loadFromFile (IRLoader.cpp:131) opens the file with dr_wav only, and there is no AIFF or FLAC decoder anywhere in octobir-core, so only WAV files load. Sample rate conversion is done on load, and an IR longer than MaxIrLengthSeconds, 10, is refused (Types.hpp:12, IRLoader.cpp:143). A slot that is enabled but empty acts as a dry path in the crossfade (IRProcessor.cpp:388, 402), so with one IR loaded and both ENABLE buttons on the blend knob becomes a dry-to-wet control.
